title: Real grass + type
note: Built around real footage. ./prepare_footage.sh cuts the two clips below from the raw phone files into C/footage/ (1920x1080). Paths are relative to this folder (or absolute). If a file is missing the page shows the labelled placeholder instead. To swap a shot: change the cut in prepare_footage.sh or point 'path' at another 16:9 file, then ./render.sh. Phone HDR clips should be tone-mapped to SDR first (these two are SDR).
